_README: Phase 13b T5.2 retrieval ground truth. Each key is a doc_hash from the 28-doc Phase 12 v10 subset (see scripts/_phase13b_poc_28doc_fallback.txt). The value is a mapping of {query: recall@10_float} OR {query: {recall@10_float, __chunk_ids: [...]}} for the per-query chunk-id Jaccard comparison. Operators populate this by running scripts/phase13b_equiv_check.py against Phase A baseline first; the Phase B run then validates against this baseline. T5.2 fails fast (exit 2) if any of the 20 sampled docs lacks a recall label (eng-review fix #2).
